  [1] File: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml (line ~608)
      Problem: The trap command for temp file cleanup captures variable values at trap registration time, not at exit time. Both jobs do:; ```bash; SECTION_FILE=""; CODEX_PROMPT_FILE=""; trap 'rm -f "${SECTION_FILE}" "${CODEX_PROMPT_FILE}"' EXIT; SECTION_FILE="$(mktemp)"; CODEX_PROMPT_FILE="$(mktemp)"; When the trap is registered, `SECTION_FILE` and `CODEX_PROMPT_FILE` are empty strings. The trap command expands these variables immediately, so the trap effectively becomes `rm -f "" ""`. Even after the variables are later assigned temp file paths, the trap still removes the empty paths (which is a no-op), leaving the actual temp files on disk.; Temp files are not actually cleaned up on exit, causing accumulation of orphaned temp files in the runner's `/tmp` directory across workflow runs.
      Confidence: avg 5.0
      Flagged by: deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash
